name: shiksha-challenges-tutorial
title: Work through a guided challenge

chapters.caption: 01  Ask for a challenge that tests reasoning, not just recall.
02  Open the challenge and predict before viewing any help.
03  Choose Solution, then reveal just the first hint.
04  Reveal the last hint and compare the ratios yourself.
05  Reveal the worked solution: both currents are 4 mA.
06  Put the solution away and explain the reasoning in chat.

description: Predict current in an original hypothetical resistor challenge, reveal two hints progressively, compare the worked answer, and explain the fixed-voltage condition in chat.
capture: Actual unchanged React frontend; scripted interactions, synthetic course data and in-memory API responses.
timing: Captured frames are paced for readability, not a performance benchmark.
isolation: Fresh browser context. External services blocked; all API calls simulated. No remote course creation.
